first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two prior findings indicate that reducing onboarding and signup friction improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and first-week activation. This is more directly aligned with sustainable revenue than discounting in response to a competitor. Verify both records to confirm segment fit and whether downstream qualification or revenue quality was measured; simplification could lift top-of-funnel activation without improving long-term qualified revenue.
